entities.name: Vicente Herrera Zeledón
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Vicente de las Mercedes Herrera Zeledón was a Costa Rican lawyer, judge and politician who served as the 7th President of Costa Rica from 1876 to 1877. He came to power in the coup d'état that deposed President Aniceto Esquivel and resigned in favor of Gen. Tomás Guardia the following year.

entities.summary: Vicente de las Mercedes Herrera Zeledón was a Costa Rican lawyer, judge and politician who served as the 7th President of Costa Rica from 1876 to 1877. He came to power in the coup d'état that deposed President Aniceto Esquivel and resigned in favor of Gen. Tomás Guardia the following year.
